<!--
Measured, not read: a journal's body is single spaced, so its tables are
single spaced by default too, where a manuscript's are double
(tests/layout-table-spacing.qmd). The .pdf's journal sets a table in a float
of its own, at the body's spacing, and is not measured here.
-->
